In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
Story 1: How India Builds Underground Tunnels
India's first undersea bullet train tunnel is a massive engineering challenge. This story explains how tunnel boring machines (TBMs) work, why underground tunnelling is so complex, the risks engineers face, and the commercial challenges of building large infrastructure projects.
